string.text: Military exercise death rate intensity
Military exercise only. 0% = human units can fall only wounded; 50% = native death rate; 100% = eligible targets always die when they fall.
11. Military exercise
Allow player death
Military exercise only. Enabled: the player may die according to the exercise death rate. Disabled: the player is always wounded instead of killed when downed.
Allow companion death

Military exercise only. Enabled: participating hero companions may die according to the exercise death rate. Disabled: participating companions are always wounded instead of killed when downed. Regular soldiers are not protected by this setting.
